bfs_largest_component.root_rule: highest degree, smallest ID breaks ties
bfs_largest_component.note: Distances from one selected root, NOT tree depth or graph diameter.

loglog_trend.note: Unweighted descriptive fit of positive C(k) means; not proof of hierarchy.

vs_discrete_exponential.note: Same fitted tail; approximate iid likelihood-ratio comparison, not a goodness-of-fit test.

hyperbolicity.note: Mean statistic, not maximum Gromov delta. Small values alone do not establish a tree or hierarchy.
